content.text:
This change is purely a UI refactor: moving a "Refine" button from inside the OccasionRow to a header slot in StylistView, and adjusting the chip row to non-scrolling flex layout. There is:

- No new user input handling, no new sinks (no shell/SQL/fs/URL/HTML-render/deserialization/logging/SSRF).
- No auth/authorization logic, no data flow across trust boundaries.
- All rendered strings are static labels (`OCCASIONS` list). No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no dynamic template interpolation.
- Callbacks (`onOccasion`, `onRefine`, `onOpenRefine`) are wired identically to before — the same handler `props.onOpenRefine` is passed to `RefineButton` and `props.onOccasion` to `OccasionRow`. No new capabilities exposed.
- Tests are jsdom-only, no shell/child_process.
- No regex/URL parsing changes, no allowlist edits, no permission/IAM changes, no observability sinks.

Nothing in the touched files reaches a security-relevant sink.
